protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: through v7.1.2, --restore reads argc/argv from the restore file, resets user options, and passes the stored argv to user_options_getopt without an allowlist. The root implementation likewise replaces myargc/myargv with rd->argc/rd->argv and performs a second getopt_long pass that accepts --outfile and --outfile-format, enabling crafted restore data to redirect attacker-controlled cracked output to a writable path.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 5065474b4e5ed59add2d5af6e2e9cf3857969fe3 is the first surviving public commit and already contains read_restore(), the restore-file argv replacement, and the unrestricted second parse. Later extraction, rename, and option-parser refactors preserve rather than introduce the mechanism.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: git cat-file and git show report no parent for 5065474b4e5ed59add2d5af6e2e9cf3857969fe3; the non-shallow clone has exactly this one root commit.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED NOT APPLICABLE: the 953-file initial import is the smallest surviving object in the full public history. It is tagged v2.00, later project/file renames remain in the same history, and no earlier public member is reconstructable, so the root is a valid atomic BIC under the protocol.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: CONFIRMED: 5065474b4e5ed59add2d5af6e2e9cf3857969fe3 is exactly tag v2.00 and is an ancestor of v7.1.2 (c75f446c44cd3f0742035a1394416c39bee5ea8f). The CVE.org record is PUBLISHED and declares versions 0 through 7.1.2 inclusive affected.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: fcae69f2438ff8eae0dc8e206b78067a1e465ed4 is not an ancestor of v7.1.2, is described as v7.1.2-474-gfcae69f24, and no local tag contains it; therefore no fixed tagged release is established by this snapshot.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED DIRECT FIX: non-merge commit fcae69f2438ff8eae0dc8e206b78067a1e465ed4, parent 991d61ced61f0f67efd8d580ccfaa8f7ce12c8fb, removes restore-file argv parsing from default --restore, makes it print-only, and makes --restore-position consume only saved position state. Its parent still unconditionally calls user_options_getopt on rd->argv; legacy behavior remains only behind explicit --restore-auto.

findings: CVE-2026-68766 is a real published CWE-88 vulnerability, not a withdrawn or rejected advisory; CVE.org identifies the upstream issue, v7.1.2 vulnerable source, and fcae69f2438ff8eae0dc8e206b78067a1e465ed4 as the patch.
